source_title: Save 20% (or More) Off Minecraft Dungeons 2 for Nintendo Switch 2 Ahead of Black Friday
source_excerpt:
Woot (which is owned by Amazon) just kicked off a massive video game sale today with some major discounts on Nintendo Switch, Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 games. On top of existing instant discounts, you can get an extra 20% off with coupon code " SAVETOBER ". If you're a new Woot customer, the discount increases to 30% off. Amazon Prime members get free shipping, otherwise add a $5 delivery fee.
Save 20% Off Minecraft Dungeons 2 for Nintendo Switch 2
30% off for first time Woot customers
Minecraft Dungeons 2 (Nintendo Switch 2)
One of the newest Switch 2 games that is currently eligible is Minecraft Dungeons 2 . It's normally priced at $44.99, but you can get it for $35.99 after you apply the code. This is a brand new, retail-boxed US physical copy. Minecraft Dungeons 2 came out on September 29, just about a month ago, so a 20% discount is much earlier than anticipated.
Minecraft Dungeons 2 is an isometric action RPG that involves taking on dungeons, collecting loot, and equipping your character with the best gear powerful. It's similar to Diablo but it takes place in the world of Minecraft and adopts its iconic blocky art style. IGN's Travis Northrup reviewed it and gave it an "Okay" score, but it's obvious this game is targeted towards a younger Minecraft loving audience. My kids absolutely love playing this game with their friends, and I'm sure they're not alone. Pick this game up at a good discount and gift it to one very happy kid this holiday season.
